UAE vessel attacked; Iran demands US change behavior for Hormuz Strait opening

The United Arab Emirates accused Iran of piracy after one of its vessels was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran stated the strait will not reopen until the United States "corrects its behavior," demanding compensation and the lifting of sanctions. Iran also reportedly seeks to ban U.S. and Israeli ships from the waterway. Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey signed a defense pact, with Iran repeating that a deal for the Hormuz Strait is close.
